headline: Flagler top the table with two wins from two
dek: Flagler drew all three of their matches outside the conference, then won their first two inside it, at Georgia Southwestern and at home to Clayton State. North Georgia, unbeaten too, have drawn with Lander and beaten USC Aiken since conference play opened.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Georgia's sixteen goals are more than USC Aiken and Lander have scored between them, and nine different players have shared them.

wire.line: Flagler won both conference matches after drawing every match before them; they and North Georgia are the only unbeaten sides.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, among them Clayton State's visit to Oglethorpe and Middle Georgia State's to Columbia on 22 August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored six of North Georgia's sixteen goals from nineteen shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored six of Middle Georgia State's twelve goals from twenty-one shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Theo Hoang has scored five of Georgia Southwestern's eight goals from nine shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ryan Rivas has conceded twice in Flagler's goal this season.

last_match.line: Flagler remain unbeaten; every Clayton State defeat has come away from home.

next_match.line: North Georgia have yet to lose; Clayton State have won every match at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
